Priya (PM): Quick thread to finalize Reserved Pools + Quota MVP scope. We need a concise launch checklist and fallback playbook for sales/legal. Goal: GA-ready for priority pilots in 3 weeks.

Ravi (Eng-Platform): Proposal: MVP features = reserved pool allocation, per-tenant quota slab, token-bucket burst credits, simple fallback routing, and minimal telemetry. Keep per-route controls out of scope.

Noah (Eng-ML): For fallback routing prefer a quality-tiered chain: 1) quantized same-arch model, 2) smaller architecture, 3) best-effort queue. We should expose a single toggle for customers: "prefer-quality" vs "prefer-availability".

Lena (Customer Success): Pilots prefer explicit guarantees: "X concurrent requests guaranteed for 5m bursts" and a clear contract clause that describes fallback behavior and expected quality delta. They also want console visibility when fallback is active.

Chris (Eng-SRE): Operational constraints: autoscale should respect tenant commitment. Suggest mapping table: commitment -> max_replicas_multiplier. Also require graceful drain time and a preempt budget for emergency throttles. Add alert: burst_credit_depletion with severity page.

Priya (PM): Good. Define launch KPIs: 1) P95 generation latency for reserved traffic <=250ms, 2) zero 5xx errors under burst up to committed capacity, 3) burst absorption for 5m windows for 90% of events, 4) onboard time <= 2 hours.

Marta (Legal): For contracts we need fallback language and opt-out terms. If fallback changes output quality we must include notice period and consent checkbox in Console. We can draft standard clause but need CS sign-off for pilot exceptions.

Ravi (Eng-Platform): Minimal autoscale config example (pseudo): `policy: {up_pct: 75, down_pct: 30, min: commit_base, max: commit_base*4, burst_window_s: 300, fallback_order: [quantized, small, queue], queue_ms: 150}`. Keep name/value simple for docs.

Noah (Eng-ML): Add a lightweight eval hook: when fallback activates sign post requests and run a short fidelity check against held eval prompts to detect unacceptable regression. If regression > threshold trigger rollback route.

Lena (Customer Success): UX asks: Console should show active quota, remaining burst credits, last fallback reason, and an obvious "escalate to CS" button for pilot customers. Also email notify on sustained fallback > 2m.

Chris (Eng-SRE): Telemetry summary: per-tenant headroom_pct, burst_credits_remaining, fallback.count, fallback.reason histogram, recent_burst_events (1m/5m windows). Need retention 30d for troubleshooting.

Priya (PM): Prioritization: MUST = reserved allocations, token-bucket, fallback chain, basic telemetry, contract language. SHOULD = console banner + email notifications, pilot onboarding doc. MAYBE = self-serve quota editing, per-route admission.

Ravi (Eng-Platform): Risk: prewarm cost if we follow pre-warmed micro-pool approach. For MVP we avoid prewarm and rely on fast quantized variants + limited queue. Calls out potential latency tail increases.

Marta (Legal): Also flag SLAs: if we promise burst guarantees we need operational playbook and credits for breaches. Keep SLA language conservative for GA.

Priya (PM): Rollout plan: week1 internal canary (0.5% traffic), week2 pilot tenants (5-10%), week3 pilot expansion + legal signoff -> GA. Gate: 3 pilots onboarded OR telemetry showing stable burst absorption for 48h, AND legal fallback language approved.

Noah (Eng-ML): Quick note: ensure model registry tags for "quantized" and "small" variants so routing is deterministic.

Lena (Customer Success): I'll collect pilot redlines and provide a one-pager for sales messaging.

Chris (Eng-SRE): I'll add incident runbook entries: fallback active, fallback degraded quality, burst credit drain. Also add test harness: synthetic 5m burst + preemption scenarios.

Ravi (Eng-Platform): I'll open PR with autoscale policy + token-bucket impl + telemetry schema by Thu EOD.
